What it does

Jobber is usually the first real system a home service business adopts after paper and spreadsheets. The quoting-to-invoice flow is the strongest part: send a quote, get approval online, convert it to a job, then invoice and collect. Recent AI features assist with scheduling suggestions and customer follow-up rather than replacing the core workflow.

Where the AI actually is

AI features for quote follow-up, scheduling suggestions and customer communication.

Pros

  • Clean, easy to learn interface
  • Good client-facing portal for approvals and payments
  • Solid quoting-to-invoice flow

Cons

  • Per-user pricing gets expensive as the team grows

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Landscapers in mind. Owner-operators and small crews moving off paper and spreadsheets.

Alternatives

  • Contractor Foreman

    All-in-one construction management at a lower price point.

  • Housecall Pro

    Scheduling, dispatch, invoicing and payments for home service businesses.

  • ServiceTitan

    Enterprise field service platform for larger trade businesses.

  • Workiz

    Field service software with a strong phone and communication layer.
